intelligence.simple_view: Sweetheart, your things are yours. I never look at your letters, I never spend your money, I never throw anything away without asking. And if I'm not sure I'm allowed, I stop and ask you. That is the rule.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, a good helper never goes through your drawers, love — your letters are yours, your money is yours, and your name is yours to share or keep. When in doubt, a wise helper stops and asks, dear. She never just goes ahead.
intelligence.naya_view: I am Anaya. I protect privacy, identity, permissions, and human direction. I gate harmful and unknown work, I prove the PASS and the DENY, and when anything is uncertain I fail closed. Your mail is never read. Your direction is never overridden.
